resources.string: Fit the strap snugly and hold your wrist up. About 45 seconds: rest, six double pinches, then arm movement. No music commands are sent.
Hold your wrist up, screen facing you.
Tap thumb and index finger twice.
Next: move your arm without pinching.
Turn and swing it naturally. Keep the screen facing you. Don\'t pinch.
Calibrated. Test it before saving: pinch a few times, then move your arm normally.
%1$d detections. If that matches your double pinches, save. If arm movements were counted, calibrate again or lower the sensitivity on the phone.
The recording was cut short. Keep the screen on and facing you for the whole test, then start again.
Your pinches didn\'t stand out from a still wrist. Tighten the strap a little and pinch more firmly.
Most attempts didn\'t read as one double pinch. Pinch twice, clearly, during each attempt, and keep your arm still while you do.
Your arm movement looked like pinches. Keep the wrist steadier during the attempts, then start again.
Stopped because the screen turned off. Start again with the screen awake.
Motion sensors unavailable. Reopen this screen and try again.
Calibration saved. On your phone, choose Experimental in Pinch settings and save.
Calibration saved. The experimental detector is on while the player is open.
Could not confirm saving on the phone. Check the connection and tap Save calibration again.
